rule.name: SpringConstructorInjection
rule.message: Inject through the constructor into private final fields. Do not put @Autowired, @Inject, @Resource or @Value on fields or setters.

property.name: xpath
property.value: ( //FieldDeclaration/ModifierList/Annotation | //MethodDeclaration/ModifierList/Annotation )[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired') or (pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.inject.Inject') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.inject.Inject')) or (pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.annotation.Resource') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.annotation.Resource')) or (pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value') and (parent::ModifierList/parent::FieldDeclaration or parent::ModifierList/parent::MethodDeclaration[not(ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean')])]))] | //ConstructorDeclaration[count(../ConstructorDeclaration) = 1]/ModifierList/Annotation[ pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired') or (pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.inject.Inject') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.inject.Inject'))]
